label: Internal pre-expression-X analysis specification created after both bulk results; exploratory cell-context discrimination, not public preregistration or replacement validation
question: In corrected GSE282122 UC colonic samples, does the six-gene signal after adalimumab reflect mature-colonocyte captured composition, within-state expression change, or both?
cross_cohort_boundary: This adalimumab cohort uses clinical remission and variable follow-up; it can inform portability of composition-versus-state explanations but cannot prove why the GSE73661 IFX endoscopic association arose.

fixed_annotation_states.rule: Use released final_analysis/major labels; do not recluster or create a candidate-high state for this analysis.

sample_unit.sites: All non-terminal-ileum same-patient same-site Pre/Post pairs
sample_unit.site_handling: Compute within-site Post-minus-Pre quantities, then take an equal-weight mean over eligible sites within each patient.
sample_unit.missing_outcome: UC19 and UC21 are excluded from outcome contrasts and never recoded as non-remission.
sample_unit.author_paired_list: 29 site pairs/17 patients with both samples on author list; report as provenance/sensitivity subset, not replacement main sample.

cell_rule.main: Corrected released cells with nonmissing final_analysis, restricted to fixed samples, excluding predicted_doublets==TRUE.
cell_rule.mandatory_sensitivity: All corrected released annotated cells including the predicted_doublets flag.
cell_rule.no_new_global_QC_threshold: Do not select mitochondrial/gene-count thresholds from response results. Report source QC distributions and any technical invalidity before modeling.

composition_axis.primary: CT cell count / all non-ileal epithelial cells within each sample.
composition_axis.secondary: CT cell count / all retained captured cells within each sample.
composition_axis.zero_rule: Pseudocount 0.5 is fixed for both groups.

within_state_axis.main_cell_threshold: At least20 state cells in both visits of a site pair.
within_state_axis.aggregation: Sum raw candidate counts and all-gene library counts within sample-by-state; no cell-level inferential P values.
within_state_axis.score: Mean across six genes of log2(((gene_count+0.5)/(state_total_UMI+1))*1e6); site-pair Post-minus-Pre, then patient equal-site mean.
within_state_axis.broader_state_mapping: Report all released non-ileal epithelial states descriptively with BH across the fixed state family; no relabeling or primary-state substitution.

two_component_decomposition.role: Descriptive exact algebra on linear per-cell-normalized six-gene expression, not causal mediation.
two_component_decomposition.groups: CT versus all other non-ileal epithelial cells
two_component_decomposition.eligibility: Both groups present and at least20 CT cells in both visits; threshold10/50 sensitivities.
two_component_decomposition.cell_expression: For each cell/gene, count/total_cell_UMI*10000; average six genes and cells within CT or other.
two_component_decomposition.formula: Total change = composition contribution + within-state contribution by symmetric Kitagawa two-group decomposition.
two_component_decomposition.claims: May quantify whether observed normalized epithelial change is arithmetically carried by changing group weights versus changing group means; does not establish histologic equivalence or causality.

main_contrasts: Patient-level change in primary composition metric by remission
Patient-level change in CT within-state six-gene score by remission
statistics.reporting: Group means, remission-minus-nonremission difference, OLS95%CI, HC3 sensitivity, exact label-permutation P when all combinations feasible; BH across the two named main contrasts. Also report all-patient paired change descriptively.
statistics.chemistry_confounding: All remitters are v3.1. Mandatory sensitivity restricts to v3.1; chemistry-adjusted model may be shown as descriptive but cannot identify an outcome effect independently of all batch/time differences.
statistics.additional_metrics: All-cell denominator, author paired subset, thresholds10/50, released-cell set are sensitivities. Do not select the branch with smallest P.
statistics.small_sample_rule: Report exact patient/event counts and wide intervals. No clinical prediction claims.

interpretation_rules.composition_only_pattern: Positive CT-composition change without a stable within-CT score change supports a composition-dominant explanation in this cohort.
interpretation_rules.state_pattern: A stable within-CT score change supports a composition-incomplete explanation in this cohort.
interpretation_rules.both_pattern: Report both without calling either causal or dominant unless decomposition estimates and uncertainty support that wording.
interpretation_rules.neither_pattern: The bulk association does not transfer to this distinct adalimumab clinical-remission context.
interpretation_rules.nondecisive: Any pattern cannot by itself settle construct overlap in GSE73661 because drug, endpoint and follow-up differ.
forbidden_claims: six-gene program independent of all inflammation
six-gene program superior to CT, IA13/JAK-STAT or OXPHOS

technical_amendment_rule: If actual H5AD encoding or count semantics differ, stop before outcome modeling, record a versioned technical amendment and rerun from unchanged scientific contrasts. No outcome-dependent sample, state, threshold or normalization changes.
